name: markdown-format
description: Auto-format and lint Markdown on edit via markdownlint-cli2, only in repos that carry their own markdownlint config.

markdown_format_enabled.title: Format and lint on edit
markdown_format_enabled.description: Auto-format and lint Markdown on Write/Edit of .md/.mdc files (runs only when the repo carries a markdownlint config)

markdown_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
markdown_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves gitignored files alone: a scratch tier the repo excludes is neither rewritten nor reported on. Set true to bypass this hook's git check; markdownlint-cli2's own ignores and gitignore config still apply, so a path your markdownlint config excludes stays untouched.

markdown_format_max_findings.title: Max findings reported per run
markdown_format_max_findings.description: How many individual markdownlint violations are listed per run. The total count and the leading rule codes are always reported regardless. 0 = unlimited.
